signature.name: VTask.modulus
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> {β : Type u_2} -> [PseudoMetricSpace α] -> [CompactSpace α] -> [PseudoMetricSpace β] -> (f : C(α, β)) -> (ε : ℝ) -> (h : 0 < ε) -> ℝ

conventions.statement: The returned value VTask.modulus f ε h is always strictly positive.
conventions.note: Any valid modulus of uniform continuity must be positive; the classical choice respects this.

conventions.statement: The exact numerical value of VTask.modulus f ε h is not determined beyond satisfying the uniform continuity condition; it is an arbitrary classical choice.
conventions.note: Users should not rely on any specific value, only on the specification it satisfies.

conventions.statement: For all x y : α with dist x y < VTask.modulus f ε h, we have dist (f x) (f y) < ε.
conventions.note: This is the defining property the chosen modulus satisfies, inherited from the underlying uniform continuity witness.

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} {β : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace α] [CompactSpace α] [PseudoMetricSpace β] (f : C(α, β)) (ε : ℝ) (h : 0 < ε), 0 < VTask.modulus f ε h
